title: benchmark gold assertion JSONL record
description: One JSON object per line in the assertion file consumed by benchmark.

entity.description: Row key value, or a JSON string array for a composite key.

field.description: Exact candidate column name to compare.

expected.description: Expected value in its source-text representation.

compare_as.description: Comparison mode; string is the loader default.

tolerance.description: Optional non-negative absolute tolerance, legal for number and percent comparisons.

severity.description: Assertion importance; major is the loader default.

source.description: Optional provenance for the human-validated fact.
